top_signals.title: Stocks, Bonds Rise After US Vote as Dollar Falls: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A Democratic sweep of Congress rippled across global markets, with stocks fluctuating while the dollar fell and Treasuries gained on bets the outcome will put the brakes on President Donald Trump’s agenda.

top_signals.title: India Sees Some Trade Relief, New Risks After US Midterm Vote
top_signals.summary: Indian officials were cautious on the US midterm election results, saying it eases some of the pressure over trade tensions but creates a new layer of uncertainty in an already fragile relationship.
